notes: Cancel posting of stock transactions (GL / AR / AP): port of MAKE_REVERSE_ACC / MAKE_REVERSE_CUSTOMER / MAKE_REVERSE_SUPP of ST_POSTING_CPOSTING.fmb in app_proc_st.cancel_trns; the voucher number is kept on ST_TRNS_MAST so a re-post reuses it (legacy design).

proc.description_a: إلغاء ترحيل حركات المخازن من الأنظمة الأخرى: الحسابات العامة (حذف القيد وحركات الصندوق/البنك الآلية وإلغاء علامة الترحيل)، العملاء (حذف حركة العميل وتخفيض رصيده) والموردين (حذف حركة المورد وحركات الخصم والمصروفات المرتبطة). لا يمكن إلغاء ترحيل حركة في فترة مقفلة. الحركة المسدد جزء منها لدى العملاء لا يلغى ترحيلها وتظهر رسالتها في الجدول. إذا كان القيد مجمعاً لأكثر من حركة يجب اختيار (إلغاء القيود المجمعة).
proc.description_e: Cancel the posting of stock transactions: GL (delete the voucher and the automatic cash / bank documents, reset the posting flag), AR (delete the customer transaction and reduce the balance) and AP (delete the supplier transaction and the linked discount / expense transactions). Transactions in a closed period are refused. Partly paid customer invoices are skipped and listed below. Vouchers shared by several transactions need the option 'cancel collected vouchers'.

params.name: FROM_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(t.desc_e, t.desc_a), t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where nvl(t.join_type, 1) <> 1 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by t.trns_type_code

params.name: TO_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(t.desc_e, t.desc_a), t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where nvl(t.join_type, 1) <> 1 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by t.trns_type_code desc

params.name: FROM_CUSTOMER
params.lov_sql: select c.code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(c.name_e, c.name_a), c.name_a) d, c.code r from customer c where nvl(c.customer_status, 0) = 1 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or c.code in (select cp.customer_code from ar_cust_password cp where cp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by c.code

params.name: TO_CUSTOMER
params.lov_sql: select c.code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(c.name_e, c.name_a), c.name_a) d, c.code r from customer c where nvl(c.customer_status, 0) = 1 and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or c.code in (select cp.customer_code from ar_cust_password cp where cp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by c.code desc

params.name: FROM_SALESMAN
params.lov_sql: select s.code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a) d, s.code r from salesman s where (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or s.code in (select sp.salesman_code from ar_salesman_password sp where sp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by s.code

params.name: TO_SALESMAN
params.lov_sql: select s.code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a) d, s.code r from salesman s where (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or s.code in (select sp.salesman_code from ar_salesman_password sp where sp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by s.code desc

proc.confirm_a: سيتم حذف قيود وحركات العملاء والموردين الناتجة عن ترحيل الحركات المحددة. هل تريد الاستمرار؟
proc.success_a: انتهت عملية الغاء الترحيل - راجع رسائل الحركات التي لم يلغ ترحيلها في الجدول
proc.preview_sql: select m.trns_type_code, decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(t.desc_e, t.desc_a), t.desc_a) type_desc, m.trns_serial, m.trns_date, m.doc_no, m.store_code, coalesce(m.customer_code, m.supplier_code) partner_code, nvl(m.post_flag, 0) gl_posted, case when t.join_type = 3 then nvl(m.cust_post_flag, 0) end ar_posted, case when t.join_type = 4 then nvl(m.supp_post_flag, 0) end ap_posted, case when m.ac_entry_no is not null then m.ac_entry_year || '/' || m.ac_entry_type || '/' || m.ac_entry_no end gl_entry, (select count(*) from st_trns_mast x where x.ac_entry_year = m.ac_entry_year and x.ac_entry_type = m.ac_entry_type and x.ac_entry_no = m.ac_entry_no and nvl(x.post_flag, 0) = 1 and nvl(x.delete_flag, 0) = 0) voucher_trns, (select listagg(p.message, ' | ') within group (order by p.message) from st_post_msg p where p.trns_type_code = m.trns_type_code and p.trns_serial = m.trns_serial) post_message from st_trns_mast m join st_trns_type t on t.trns_type_code = m.trns_type_code where nvl(m.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and t.join_type in (2, 3, 4) and (:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER = 0 or m.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and m.trns_date between nvl(to_date(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_FROM_DATE'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'), trunc(sysdate, 'YYYY')) and nvl(to_date(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_TO_DATE'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'), sysdate) and m.trns_type_code between nvl(to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_FROM_TYPE')), 0) and nvl(to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_TO_TYPE')), 999999999999) and (v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_FROM_SERIAL') is null or m.trns_serial >= to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_FROM_SERIAL'))) and (v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_TO_SERIAL') is null or m.trns_serial <= to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_TO_SERIAL'))) and (nvl(m.post_flag, 0) = 1 or nvl(m.cust_post_flag, 0) = 1 or nvl(m.supp_post_flag, 0) = 1 or exists (select 1 from st_post_msg p where p.trns_type_code = m.trns_type_code and p.trns_serial = m.trns_serial)) order by m.trns_type_code, m.trns_serial
